links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no reading-level instruction (default AI condition)
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of AI-generated medication counseling passages
links.effect: Pooled default AI FKGL 12.19 ± 4.85 vs pooled sixth-grade-prompted AI FKGL 7.63 ± 3.16; decreased across all three models (all P ≤ 0.001)
links.tradeoff: Study addressed readability only; accuracy, completeness and comprehension were not assessed. Pooled sixth-grade AI FKGL (7.63) still exceeded the sixth-grade target.
links.quote: sixth-grade prompting markedly decreased FKGL across all three models (all P ≤ 0.001).
